task_name: PR-004B least-privilege private schema service-role fix
user_visible_outcome: Existing PR-004B public security-invoker wrappers work for the server's service-role client without exposing private functions or broadening database access.
user_journeys: An active admin can publish, later edit and republish, and unpublish a shared chapter through the existing server path.
An active admin can use the existing public draft photograph replacement wrapper without a private-schema permission error.
Anon and authenticated clients remain unable to execute the private PR-004B functions.
non_negotiable_quality: The existing public wrappers remain security invoker.
Only service_role receives USAGE on the private schema.
Only the exact three private functions reached by public PR-004B wrappers receive service_role EXECUTE.
PUBLIC, anon, and authenticated retain no EXECUTE privilege on those private functions.
No table grants, RLS policies, admin rules, Data API exposure, source code, seed data, email configuration, dependencies, or existing migrations change.
All verification uses only the local Supabase stack and synthetic fixtures.
realistic_harms_prevented: A server-side admin action must not fail after passing application authorization because PostgreSQL cannot enter the private schema.
A permission repair must not expose privileged private functions to browsers or ordinary authenticated users.
A migration must not silently bypass RLS or change the public wrapper trust boundary.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The migration grants service_role USAGE on private and grants service_role EXECUTE only on private.publish_content_revision(uuid,uuid), private.unpublish_content_revision(uuid,uuid), and private.is_active_admin(uuid).
PUBLIC, anon, and authenticated cannot execute each granted private function, and no table privilege, RLS policy, admin rule, Data API exposure, or public-wrapper security mode changes.

Under service_role, the existing public wrappers complete first publish, later draft edit and republish, unpublish, and draft photograph replacement while both active-admin authorization and immutable revision semantics remain enforced.
A clean local reset, full pgTAP, type-check, lint, full tests, production build, and git diff whitespace validation pass.
acceptance_criteria.proof_command: supabase db reset; supabase test db; npm.cmd run type-check; npm.cmd run lint; npm.cmd test; npm.cmd run build; git diff --check

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The task result validates against this contract, records every granted private function, and closes project and global decision ledgers without release action.

non_goals: Convert any public wrapper to security definer.
Grant private-schema access or private-function execution to PUBLIC, anon, or authenticated.
Change any table grants, RLS policies, admin-user rules, Data API exposure, seed data, email configuration, product source, dependencies, or prior migrations.
Access remote Supabase, commit, push, deploy, or begin production verification.
simplest_acceptable_approach: Add one forward-only migration that grants service_role only the private-schema USAGE and three exact existing private-function EXECUTE privileges required by the current public security-invoker PR-004B wrappers, repeats restrictive revocations for untrusted roles, and adds focused pgTAP service-role execution proof without changing application code or any broader permission boundary.
verification: wrapper call graph and grant inspection
final scope gate with result JSON
